A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served at one point in their life as the military [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Daschua]]. The governor had several sons, the eldest of whom was named [[Zertik Strom/Legends|Zertik Strom]], who went on to serve in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]].<ref name="VSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zertik Strom's father was first mentioned in the second entry of ''[[Viva Space Vegas! The History of the Marvelous Wheel]]'', a pair of articles released in [[2013]] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Rich Handley]]. The article does not name the character or make clear what type of location Daschua is.
